01

“and they will not be tried”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 29:2, 29:3).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and they will not be tried [al-Ankabut 2] He says: "tested in their wealth and persons"; And We have already tried [al-Ankabut 3] meaning: "We have tested."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ [العنكبوت: 2] يَقُولُ: «لَا يُبْتَلُونَ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ» ، وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا [العنكبوت: 3] ، يَعْنِي: «ابْتَلَيْنَا»
Edition record 373026 · p. 534Link to report ↗

03

“But when he is harmed for the sake of God, he regards the…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 29:10, 29:11).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
But when he is harmed for the sake of God, he regards the persecution of people as the punishment of God [al-Ankabut 10] up to His words and God will surely make evident the hypocrites [al-Ankabut 11], he said: "They are people who believed with their tongues, and when affliction from people or a calamity in their persons or wealth struck them, they were tried, and treated what struck them in this world as the punishment of God in the Hereafter."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَإِذَا أُوذِيَ فِي اللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ النَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ اللَّهِ [العنكبوت: 10] إِلَى قَوْلِهِ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ [العنكبوت: 11] قَالَ: «هُمْ أُنَاسٌ آمَنُوا بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ، فَإِذَا أَصَابَهُمْ بَلَاءٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ أَوْ مُصِيبَةٌ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ أَوْ فِي أَمْوَالِهِ فُتِنُوا، فَجَعَلُوا مَا أَصَابَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَعَذَابِ اللَّهِ فِي الْآخِرَةِ»
Edition record 373028 · p. 534Link to report ↗
04

“Follow our way and we will carry your sins”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 29:12).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Follow our way and we will carry your sins [al-Ankabut 12] he said: "This is the saying of the disbelievers of Quraysh in Mecca to those among them who believed. They said: 'Neither we nor you will be resurrected, so follow us, and if anything falls upon you, it is upon us.'"
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
اتَّبِعُوا سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَايَاكُمْ [العنكبوت: 12] قَالَ: " هَذَا قَوْلُ كُفَّارِ قُرَيْشٍ بِمَكَّةَ مَنْ آمَنَ مِنْهُمْ، قَالُوا: لَا نُبْعَثُ نَحْنُ وَلَا أَنْتُمْ فَاتَّبِعُونَا، فَإِنْ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ شَيْءٌ فَهُوَ عَلَيْنَا "
Edition record 373029 · p. 534Link to report ↗
05

“And they will surely carry their burdens and other burdens along…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 29:13).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And they will surely carry their burdens and other burdens along with their burdens [al-Ankabut 13] he said: It is like His words: that they may bear their burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they mislead without knowledge [al-Nahl 25].
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًا مَعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ [العنكبوت: 13] قَالَ: هُوَ كَقَوْلِهِ لِيَحْمِلُوا أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ الَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ [النحل: 25]
Edition record 373030 · p. 534Link to report ↗

10

“and the remembrance of God is greater”

Two explanations transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 29:45).

10
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 10

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Abd God ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr al-Laythi, from Ibn Abbas, on His words:
and the remembrance of God is greater [al-Ankabut 45], he said: "He says: God's remembrance of you is greater than your remembrance of Him."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ [العنكبوت: 45] ، قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: ذِكْرُ اللَّهِ إِيَّاكُمْ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ ذِكْرِكُمْ إِيَّاهُ "
Edition record 373035 · p. 535Link to report ↗

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 29:46).

12
Explanation from Mujāhid 12

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in the way that is best [al-Ankabut 46] He says: "if they say something evil, say something good."

الإسناد

وَلَا تُجَادِلُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ [العنكبوت: 46] يَقُولُ: «إِنْ قَالُوا شَرًّا فَقُولُوا خَيْرًا»

12

“except for those of them who commit injustice”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

13
Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
except for those of them who commit injustice [al-Baqara 150] meaning: "that they said: 'There is a god with God,' and said: 'He has a son and a partner, and His hand is chained, and He is poor,' exalted and blessed is He, and they harmed Muhammad ﷺ; and they are the People of the Book. So God, Mighty and Majestic, said: except for those of them who commit injustice [al-Baqara 150]. He says: so defeat them."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
إِلَّا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْهُمْ [البقرة: 150] ، يَعْنِي: " أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا: مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهٌ، وَقَالُوا: لَهُ وَلَدٌ، وَلَهُ شَرِيكٌ، وَيَدُهُ مَغْلُولَةٌ، وَهُوَ فَقِيرٌ تبارك وتعالى، وَآذَوْا مُحَمَّدًا ﷺ، وَهُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ. فَقَالَ اللَّهُ عز وجل: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْهُمْ [البقرة: 150] يَقُولُ: فَانْتَصُرُوا مِنْهُمْ "
Edition record 373038 · p. 536Link to report ↗

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:

17

“And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision; God…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 29:60).

18
Explanation from Mujāhid 18

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision; God provides for it [al-Ankabut 60] he said: "among them are the beasts and the birds that do not carry their provision."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ لَا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا اللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا [العنكبوت: 60] قَالَ: «مِنْهَا الْبَهَائِمُ، وَالطَّيْرُ لَا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا»

18

“and indeed, the home of the Hereafter, that is the [true] life”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 29:64).

19
Explanation from Mujāhid 19

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and indeed, the home of the Hereafter, that is the [true] life [al-Ankabut 64] He says: "there is no death in it."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَإِنَّ الدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ لَهِيَ الْحَيَوَانُ [العنكبوت: 64] يَقُولُ: «لَا مَوْتَ فِيهَا»
